Location	Chatswood, NSW, 2067
Full-Time	Immediate start
Job Title	Advertising Specialist
Salary Range	$79,500 - $90,000 | depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closes Date	30 Days  

About the Client
On behalf of our client, a growing organization delivering integrated property, construction, and project management services, we are seeking an Advertising Specialist. This role is central to driving brand visibility and supporting sales objectives through strategic, data-informed campaigns.

Key Duties and Responsibilities
• Plan, develop, and manage advertising campaigns tailored to property and construction markets, ensuring alignment with sales objectives and project timelines.
• Advise senior management and external stakeholders on targeted advertising strategies to reach homebuyers, investors, and commercial clients, emphasizing property attributes and market positioning.
• Coordinate end-to-end campaign production, including artwork, copywriting, media scripting, and placement across digital, print, and broadcast channels, while adhering to budget and scheduling constraints.
• Commission and analyze market research to identify demand for new developments and existing property portfolios, using statistical data to refine pricing and sales strategies.
• Oversee digital marketing initiatives, including content creation, scheduling, and publishing across social media and websites, with a focus on driving engagement and lead generation.
• Monitor campaign performance through analytics tools, providing detailed reports and actionable insights to optimize ROI and adjust tactics in real time.
• Apply statistical modelling to evaluate the impact of pricing strategies on profitability, supporting competitive positioning in the property sector.
• Recommend and implement updates to website and digital content to improve search engine rankings and user experience.

Requirements
• 2+ years’ experience in advertising, marketing, or brand management, preferably in agriculture, food production, or premium consumer goods
• Demonstrated success developing campaigns that increased market share for premium products
• Exceptional ability to translate technical agricultural information into compelling consumer messaging
• Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting market research and sales data
• Proficiency with digital marketing tools, CRM platforms, and analytics software
• Outstanding project management capabilities with experience managing budgets and timelines
• Degree in Marketing, Communications, Agricultural Business, or related field.

How to Apply: 
Submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and interest in agricultural mechanical systems.

Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

result.description: Civil Network Corp pty ltd  We are seeking a motivated and highly organised  Experienced Telstra & NBN Fibre technicians  to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for installing, commissioning, testing and maintaining fibre optic telecommunications infrastructure across Telstra and NBN projects. You will perform fibre splicing, network testing, fault diagnosis and commissioning activities between the exchange and customer network boundary, while ensuring compliance with Telstra, NBN and company technical standards.  As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in delivering telecommunications infrastructure projects across New South Wales.(Sydney & Newcastle) You will work closely with project managers, clients and field teams to support network upgrades, customer connections and maintenance activities, while contributing to the successful delivery of high-quality telecommunications solutions.   Duties included are:    Install, commission and maintain fibre optic and telecommunications network infrastructure across Telstra and NBN projects.   Perform fibre handling, cable hauling, splicing, termination, testing and fault diagnosis using OTDR, power meters and other telecommunications testing equipment.   Conduct network fault finding, diagnostics and preventative maintenance to ensure reliable network performance.   Interpret telecommunications network plans, design drawings and technical specifications to complete field installations.   Configure, commission and test fibre optic network components to ensure network performance and service quality.   Manage client sites and coordinate field activities to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently and in compliance with client requirements.   Prepare technical reports, test results, as-built documentation, installation records and upload project artefacts through client management systems.   Assist with telecommunications network upgrades, commissioning activities and customer network connections.   Assist with minor civil works associated with the installation of telecommunications infrastructure, including conduit preparation, pit and pipe works, cable hauling and site set-up where required.   Ensure all installations and maintenance activities comply with Telstra, NBN and company technical standards, quality requirements and safety procedures.
